meta.loginDescription: Log in to {siteName} to continue your cloud certification study plan, keep practicing and track your learning progress.
meta.forgotDescription: Forgot your {siteName} password? Enter your registered email to get instructions for resetting it and continue your learning journey.

common.networkError: Can’t reach the server. Please check your network connection.

login.oauthFailed: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.oauthTimeout: Google sign-in took too long. Please try again.
login.recaptchaRequired: Please confirm you’re not a robot.
login.registerSuccess: Sign-up successful! You can log in now.
login.registerSuccessToast: Sign-up successful! Log in to get started.
login.accountExists: That username or email is already taken.

forgot.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
forgot.requestFailed: Couldn’t send the request. Please try again.
forgot.sentDescription: If {email} is linked to an account, we’ve sent a password reset link to that address. The link is valid for 30 minutes and can only be used once.
forgot.spamHint: Don’t see the email? Check your Spam / Promotions folder too.
forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you signed up with. We’ll send you a link to reset your password.

invalidReason.MISSING: This link doesn’t contain a password reset code. Please open the exact link from your email.
invalidReason.INVALID: This password reset link is invalid or has been replaced by a newer request.
invalidReason.USED: This link has already been used. Each link can only be used once.
invalidReason.EXPIRED: This link has expired. Please request a new one.

reset.tokenMissing: Password reset code not found. Please reopen the link from your email.
reset.tooFast: You’re going too fast. Please wait a moment and try again.
reset.resetFailed: Couldn’t reset your password. Please try again.
reset.checkFailed: Couldn’t verify the link. Please try again or request a new link.
reset.doneDescription: Your password has been updated. All previous sessions have been signed out for your security. Redirecting to log in in {countdown}s...
reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Create a new password for your account.
reset.expired: This link has expired. Please <link>request a new link</link>.
